## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (91%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Input flagged [F6], second model disagrees, and 0 of 5 similar cases are Benign [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 91%, InSitu 6% | Peaked, but not corroborated |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90%) | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / 1.0, flagged | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 0 of 5 Benign | None match; mostly InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 5, 6, 10) · context · Above typical; descriptive only, spot check 8/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Lymphocyte score is weak (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section may distort probabilities; the reliability flag marks this input suspect.
- InSitu is in the conformal set, and 3 of 5 similar cases are InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 11:** Confirm gland architecture is benign rather than atypical.
2. **Region 6:** Check ducts for atypical confined cells; InSitu is in the conformal set.
3. **Region 8:** Assess stroma for invasion and pleomorphism; both concepts score highest here.
